description: September 27 birthday meaning: Libra decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 27 birthday falls in Libra, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: September 27 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Generous idealism is a common reading for the 27th of September. Four degrees of Libra keeps the Sun in the first decan, where Venus rules twice and relationships take centre stage. Twenty-seven reduces to 9, a number associated with humanitarian concern and the wider view. The person who emerges is a gracious advocate, keen on fairness for strangers as well as friends.

On September 27 the Sun usually sits at about 4° Libra, in the first decan, where Venus rules the decan as well as the sign. Libra's first decan, from about September 23 to October 2, holds Venus as both sign ruler and sub-ruler. This is traditionally the most graceful and relationship-minded part of the sign. Fairness, harmony and aesthetic sense are emphasised, along with a gift for making guests feel welcome. Those born here often weigh every side of a decision, which makes them good mediators and occasionally slow choosers. The doubled Venus influence can also lead to avoiding conflict at the cost of honesty. Growth often arrives with the discovery that a fair outcome sometimes requires an uncomfortable conversation first.

sections.heading: September 27 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 27 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22.

sections.heading: Born on September 27: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 27 is the 270th day of the year (271st in a leap year). By October 24, 27 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 27, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 27 include Avril Lavigne (1984), Gwyneth Paltrow (1972) and Francesco Totti (1976).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 27?
faq.answer: September 27 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Libra, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 27 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 2 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 22 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 27?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 27 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 27?
faq.answer: September 27 is also the birthday of Avril Lavigne (1984), Gwyneth Paltrow (1972) and Francesco Totti (1976). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
